The Proving Grounds

Character Builder & Combat Resolver

Build a 2024 rules character that saves itself on your computer under your own player code, then bring it straight into combat. Track initiative, resolve attacks and saving throws, pass buffs to allies, and pull monsters from a searchable roster of 341 stat blocks.
